description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor' which extends a generic streaming actor to handle streaming of persisted entity information (with revisions) from a MongoDB backend. It manages MongoDB connections, creates data streams based on command parameters, and maps database pids to entity objects for streaming, serving as a base class for concrete implementations.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor
classes.description: An abstract Java class providing streaming functionality for persisted entities with revision handling from a MongoDB backend, using Akka Streams. It manages MongoDB connections, handles command parameters to create data streams, and maps ranging database pids to entity instances.

methods.name: AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the actor with entity mapping/unmapping functions, setting up MongoDB connection and read journal based on system config.

methods.name: AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor
methods.description: Overloaded constructor for testing, allowing injection of a custom read journal.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Overrides Akka's actor lifecycle method to close MongoDB client connection.

methods.name: getElementClass
methods.description: Abstract method that must return the Class object for the element type T.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Returns the class object for the command type, SudoStreamPids.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Extracts burst size from command, to control stream throughput.

methods.name: getInitialTimeout
methods.description: Determines the initial timeout duration based on command parameter.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Determines the idle timeout duration based on command parameter.

methods.name: batchMessages
methods.description: Batches a list of entity elements into a BatchedEntityIdWithRevisions object for streaming.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates an Akka Source stream of entities based on command parameters, managing resume points and batching.

methods.name: mapEntity
methods.description: Maps a PidWithSeqNr object to the entity type T using the provided entityMapper function.
